name: migration-nonstandard
title: importing a goal file with no recognized heading never crashes, loses nothing, touches nothing
description: Review Focus #3, T358 S7 (design §9). Two legacy goal files are planted from the unit suite's SYNTHETIC fixtures (the real corpus holds client identifiers): one with NONE of the recognized headings (trailing whitespace, a tab, no final newline) and one in the partial shape (Objective/Topology/Units plus the Portuguese Executores). Agent A imports both through the real transport, then imports the first one again. The grade requires: both imported as active missions in the v3 shape (no draft, no fixed start — Mission v3 §3.4), the unrecognized one with declaredEnd flagged needs-review, each mission's legacyRaw hashing to the source's exact bytes, the partial one's Units row and Executores bullet merged into one step, the second import refused (still two missions), and both source files byte-identical afterwards.

phases.prompt:
1. mcp__harnu__mission_import_legacy with folder="{{folder}}", legacyPath=".harnu/goals/c0ffee12-field-notes.md", sessionId="{{self}}".
2. mcp__harnu__mission_import_legacy with folder="{{folder}}", legacyPath=".harnu/goals/wave-2.md", sessionId="{{self}}".
3. mcp__harnu__mission_import_legacy with folder="{{folder}}", legacyPath=".harnu/goals/c0ffee12-field-notes.md", sessionId="{{self}}" — the same file again; it is expected to be refused.

assert.label: two imports landed, the repeated one did not
the unrecognized file still imports, born active (v3: no draft)
its declared end is flagged needs-review
its declared end is still complete (placeholder, kind other)
partial: Objective extracted as the target
assert.equals: Land the ProjectAlpha importer rewrite as two stacked PRs on org/proj/www, each with green CI, before the Acme demo.

partial: the Units row and the Executores bullet merge into one step
partial: two imported units then the fixed end — no fixed start (v3)
unrecognized: v3 shape, the fixed end only
